text:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync kickoff for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listing. Need owners for demo tenant bootstrap, AMI/region coverage, and the legal packaging (trial EULA + export control blurb). Who can take the demo account create?

sam.cloudops: I can run the sandbox bootstrap. Need the marketplace account IDs and list of regions to seed AMIs. Also: do we include GovCloud / Azure GOV in initial scope or as phase 2?

leo.product: Product question on packaging: expose a visible trial SKU (14-day) + paid SKU, or only a paid SKU with promo-based trials? Marketing leans visible trial SKU for discovery.

anne.legal: Legal note: EU customers will need localized EULA and DPA linked to SKU metadata. Also confirm telemetry opt-in for trials.

maria.partnerships: Proposed plan: (1) seed AMIs in us-east-1, eu-west-1, asia-southeast-1; (2) create demo tenant per cloud with limited quota; (3) publish two SKUs: Trial-14d and Standard-1vCPU. @anne.legal can you draft trial EULA addendum?

anne.legal: Will draft. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Need SKU descriptions and whether trial data is persisted after expiry. If persisted, retention language required.

leo.product: Trial persists data for 30 days post-expiry then auto-delete unless customer upgrades; include that in SKU docs.

sam.cloudops: For bootstrap, sample commands I'll run after we confirm IDs:
```bash
# create demo account + role
aws organizations create-account --email demo+aws@example.com --account-name redwood-demo-aws
# copy AMI to target region
aws ec2 copy-image --source-region us-west-2 --source-image-id ami-0abcd1234 --region us-east-1
```
I also need GCP service account key and Azure service principal JSON in the secure vault.

maria.partnerships: I'll upload creds to vault and share link. Marketing needs a hero screenshot + 2:1 hero image for marketplace tile. @leo.product can you export?

leo.product: Will export two sizes and a 60-word blurb. Any constraints on markdown in description?

maria.partnerships: Platform accepts plain text + one markdown field. Keep hero blurb first line <80 chars.

anne.legal: Small flag: AWS requires support contact in offer metadata. We'll need a dedicated support email for marketplace listings.

maria.partnerships: Using support+marketplace@redwood.com for metadata.

deploy-bot: FYI: staging AMI copy job queued, job id jb-89234. Will post completion here.

sam.cloudops: After AMI seeding I'll run smoke checks: auth, inference p95 < 300ms, billing metering. Quick runbook:
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer demo-token" https://demo.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
2) confirm logs in CloudWatch / Stackdriver / Azure Monitor
3) verify billing webhook receives meter events

maria.partnerships: Timeline: target demo tenants + assets by Thu EOD so legal/marketing can review Fri. Any blockers?

anne.legal: No blockers pending draft EULA.

leo.product: Hero images + SKU docs by Wed morning.

sam.cloudops: Scheduling AMI copies tonight; will post job IDs.

maria.partnerships: I'll circulate the one-pager and add this thread to the marketplace kickoff doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam.cloudops: :+1:

leo.product: :rocket:

anne.legal: :white_check_mark:
